_about: Meaning text for the placement dials page. Edit the wording freely; keep the same keys and counts (10 planets, 12 signs, 12 houses, 12 rulers).

planets.name: Sun
planets.core: Who you are becoming. The center you organize your life around.

planets.name: Moon
planets.core: What you need to feel safe, and how you react before you think.

planets.name: Mercury
planets.does: your mind and the way you say things
planets.core: How you notice, think, and put things into words.

planets.name: Venus
planets.does: what you value and what draws you in
planets.core: What you value, what attracts you, and how you bond.

planets.name: Mars
planets.does: your drive and the way you go after things
planets.core: How you go after what you want. Assertion, courage, and anger.

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.does: your appetite for growth and meaning
planets.core: Where you expand, trust, and look for the larger meaning.

planets.name: Saturn
planets.does: your sense of structure and limits
planets.core: Where you build, commit, and feel the weight of responsibility.

planets.name: Uranus
planets.does: your urge to break the pattern
planets.core: Where you need freedom and where things suddenly change.

planets.name: Neptune
planets.core: Where boundaries soften: imagination, ideals, and confusion.

planets.name: Pluto
planets.core: Where you go through deep change. Power, control, and depth.

signs.name: Gemini

signs.name: Virgo

signs.name: Libra
signs.manner: by weighing, balancing, and looking for fairness

signs.name: Scorpio
signs.manner: intensely, privately, and all the way down

signs.name: Sagittarius
signs.manner: boldly, restlessly, and in search of meaning

signs.name: Capricorn
signs.manner: with discipline, ambition, and an eye on the long game

signs.name: Aquarius
